_doc: How the monorepo splits into separate repositories: code apart from documentation, private operations apart from both. The monorepo stays the system of record until the target repositories exist; `python3 scripts/split_repos.py build --out DIR` writes each target tree from tracked files, and `check` proves every tracked file lands in exactly one target. Longest path prefix wins. Creating the repositories in the GitHub org is an owner or org-token step (docs/ops/ORG-TOKEN.md). Changed only by a reviewed PR.
state_doc: private-until-reviewed: every repository stays private. `reviewed` requires 'COUNSEL SIGN-OFF: <date>' in docs/legal/LICENSE-REVIEW.md and an entity name in LICENSE (scripts/check_license.py).

workers.summary: First code base: JavaScript on Cloudflare Workers. The seed worker and tick, bootstrapper, foundation generator, dashboard, site worker, gaplint, tests.

portable.summary: Second embodiment: the Python reference runtime and the Google Cloud and SQLite adapters. Proves the core is platform-agnostic.
portable.after_review: public-readable under the hybrid license, after the first code base

specs.summary: Architectural specifications, concepts, bootstrapping guides, legal notes, open-source governance files.

ops.summary: Everything about running the organization itself: business, funding, outreach, social, memory, agents, scripts, CI, archive of the patent drafts, brand, research, handoffs.
